**sdd/d2-postmerge-guardrails/explore**

**What**: Forensic exploration for D2 (rung-3 auto-revert guardrails) issue drafting. Confirmed via `.memory/records/2026-07.jsonl` line 194 (rec-efe45d2be9ee71f5, decision, 2026-07-11) that the "15 fossil PRs" are REAL and already triaged by the human: `brain-audit` over v0.9.5..HEAD came back empty because the v0.9.4/v0.9.5 release tags moved past the historic offender, self-stopping the cascade. 15 auto-revert branches were deleted by the human; the closed PRs persist as the intended D2 regression fixture. D2 status: LATENT-DOCUMENTED, not an active fire.

**Why**: User (orchestrator) needed grounded raw material for a GitHub issue "D2 — rung-3 auto-revert guardrails", including the actual bug list, the fossil-PR fixture, and the GitLab-porting restriction — all verifiable against real code/docs, not invented.

**Where**:
- `.github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml` (rung-3 cron: lines 33-41 tag-based BASE for schedule runs, lines 45-57 revert `github.sha` unconditionally, lines 60-68 sha-keyed idempotency guard, lines 70-87 gh pr create with `Part of #144`).
- `brain/scripts/brain-audit.mjs` (line 240/243-244: only exits 0 or 1, never 2; line 25/138: still imports `readChunkObservations` from the deprecated chunk-reader for memoryPresence).
- `brain/scripts/lib/chunk-reader.mjs` vs `brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs` (the latter went records-only per issue #229 C4/D4; brain-audit.mjs was NOT included in that migration — still chunk-based, a live drift).
- `openspec/changes/issue-229-c4/design.md` §Decision 3 confirms D4 scope was `run-check.mjs` only; real committed store moved chunks → `.memory/legacy/`.
- `docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md` §D2 (lines 327-335) — the three-exit-code contract (0 pass / 1 violation / 2 uncomputable) is the PLAN's proposed FIX, not yet implemented anywhere (zero `process.exit(2)` in the repo, no exit-code drift-guard test).
- `openspec/changes/issue-144-governance-v3/archive-report.md` lines 164-167, 247-248 — issue #165 (idempotency gap) was already raised and appears fixed in the current YAML (git ls-remote branch-exists check).

**Learned**:
1. The task-prompt's assumed "bug #1 of 3 = exit-code conflation" is real (independently confirmed — brain-audit.mjs and run-check.mjs never emit exit 2) but is NOT one of the owner's own already-diagnosed "3 underlying cron bugs." Those three, per the memory record verbatim, are: (1) **window-from-tag** — cron's schedule-run BASE resolves via `git describe --tags --abbrev=0`, so advancing a release tag past an offending merge silently drops it out of the audit window forever, masking rather than fixing it; (2) **revert-of-HEAD** — the workflow reverts `github.sha` (the push's HEAD) unconditionally instead of the specific SHA(s) brain-audit.mjs actually printed as `[FAIL]`, so on a multi-merge range it can revert good HEAD work while leaving the real offender untouched; (3) **no dedup on the offender** — because of bug 2, every subsequent push/cron cycle computes a new (wrong) target SHA, so the existing sha-keyed idempotency guard (branch-exists check) can never recognize "we already tried to handle this offender," producing a new fossil branch/PR each cycle until the tag-move (bug 1) masks it.
2. Standing restriction (verbatim, from the same memory record): "do NOT port the postmerge/auto-revert workflow to GitLab until D2 fixes these (Track A's GitLab governance ports the PR-time gates, NOT postmerge)." This lives only in engram/brain memory, not in any repo file — no ADR, spec, or workflow comment states it. Indirect code evidence: `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs`'s rung-3 detector is hardcoded to GitHub signals (`.github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml` presence, `GITHUB_ACTIONS` env) with no GitLab equivalent; Track A's A2/A3/A4 slices (PLAN §132-176) never mention porting postmerge/auto-revert, only `GOVERNANCE_JOBS` (PR-time gates).
3. Tooling constraint: this exploration had no Bash/gh/git-CLI tool available (Read/Grep/Glob/WebFetch/WebSearch/mem_save only) — could not run `gh pr list`/`git branch -r` live. Local git refs (packed-refs, refs/heads, refs/remotes) show only `main`; no live auto-revert branches/PRs are visible from this clone. All fossil-PR and bug findings are grounded in the project's own persisted memory records and code, not a live GitHub sweep.
